about_the_game:
Easy Bubles is a relaxing idle game that blends real-time fish nurturing with strategic decision-making. In this vibrant aquarium world, carefully select your fish, grow them in real time, and decide whether to sell them for profit or keep them to generate continuous income.

Key Features:

  • Expansive Fish Collection:
    Discover a diverse range of fish with a total of 58 x 7 unique types. Each fish comes in 4 distinct variants, allowing you to create a personalized and unique aquarium.

  • Seven Exclusive Fish Packs:
    Choose from 7 different fish packs, each curated to include special fish with rare and ultra-rare variants that add exclusive flair to your collection.

  • Real-Time Growth and Nurturing:
    Watch your fish grow in real time. Whether you manually nurture them or use the Auto-AFK feature, timing your actions strategically will help maximize your earnings.

  • Exclusive Booster Packs:
    Unlock rare variants by purchasing booster packs, giving you access to the most unique and visually stunning fish to set your aquarium apart.

  • Customizable Aquarium Environment:
    Personalize your aquatic haven with captivating graphics, dynamic day-night cycles, and soothing background music that create an immersive and calming atmosphere.

Easy Bubles is designed to provide an enjoyable escape from daily stress, offering both quick, engaging gameplay moments and a long-term strategic challenge. Dive into this colorful world, complete your fish collection, and experience the serene pleasure of managing your very own aquatic paradise!
